name: Wobble Creek
hint: Step 1: with Road picked, drag from the left bank anchor toward the right. A beam stops at its 6 m limit and building carries on from its end - click the far anchor to finish. Step 2: pick Wood (key 2) and drag from a lower anchor up to a road joint to make a triangle (right-click or Esc stops building). Step 3: press Test (Space).
